verdict.rationale: Pipedream's error docs cover failure notification: by default it emails you when a workflow throws an unhandled error. They also cover automatic retries of errored events and surfacing error details and stack traces. Nothing in the pack shows dedicated error-handling paths or separate error workflows, so only the notification half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: dedicated error-handling branches or error workflows, notification channels beyond email, independent or hands-on corroboration.
